title: Get App Conversion Events
content_data:
Use this endpoint to obtain information about an app conversion event. > **Important**
> By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the [TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and that you will not share sensitive data with TikTok. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path| /v1.2/app/external_action/| /v1.3/app/optimization_event/| |Request parameter name|`is_dedicated`
`optimize_goal`|`is_skan`
`optimization_goal` | |Request parameter data type|`advertiser_id`: number
`app_id`: number |`advertiser_id`: string
`app_id`: string | | New request parameter | / | `app_promotion_type`
`placement_type`| |Response parameter name |`external_actions`
`external_action` (in `external_actions`)
`is_no_bid_enabled`
`is_auto_bid_enabled`
`is_multi_bid_enabled`
`deep_external_actions`
`external_action` (in `deep_external_actions`) |`optimization_events`
`optimization_event` (in `optimization_events`)
`no_bid_enabled`
`auto_bid_enabled`
`multi_bid_enabled`
`deep_optimization_events`
` optimization_event`(in `deep_optimization_events`)| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/app/optimization_event/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string|Advertiser ID | |app_id {Required}|string|Your App ID, obtained after successfully creating your app. | |placement_type |string|The placement strategy that decides where your ads will be shown.
Enum values: `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` (Automatic placement), `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` (Select placement).
Default value: `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`.| |placement {+Conditional}|string[]|The apps where you want to deliver your ads.
Required when `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`, and ignored when `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`.

Note:

  • Currently, we support `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`, `PLACEMENT_PANGLE` and `PLACEMENT_GLOBAL_APP_BUNDLE`. Please don't select `PLACEMENT_TOPBUZZ` or `PLACEMENT_HELO` as your `placements` since they've been deprecated. For a full list of enum values, see [Enumeration - Placement](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737174886619138).
  • For Product Sales campaigns (`objective_type` = `PRODUCT_SALES`), only TikTok placement (`PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`) is supported.
| |optimization_goal {Required}|string|Optimization goal. For enum values, see [Enumeration-Optimization Goal](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737174886619138) for more| |objective {Required}|string|Advertising Objective. For enum values, see [Enumeration-Advertising Objective](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737174886619138) | | app_promotion_type {+Conditional} | string | App promotion type. Required when `objective` is `APP_PROMOTION`. Enum values: `APP_INSTALL`, `APP_RETARGETING`.

Note: `APP_INSTALL` can be used in an iOS14 Dedicated Campaign, while `APP_RETARGETING` cannot be used. | |available_only | boolean| Whether to return only available conversion events. The default value: `True` (only return available conversion events)| |is_skan|boolean|Whether the app is using Skan features. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --get -H "Access-Token:xxx" \ --data-urlencode "advertiser_id=ADVERTISER_ID" \ --data-urlencode "objective=OBJECTIVE" \ --data-urlencode "placement=[\"PLACEMENT\"]" \ --data-urlencode "app_id=APP_ID" \ --data-urlencode "optimize_goal=OPTIMIZE_GOAL" \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/app/optimization_event/ (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data |object|Return data| #|optimization_events|object[]| external action list| ##|optimization_event |string|conversion events that you want to measure. See [Appendix-Conversion Events-App Event Type](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739361474981889)| ##|statistic_type| string |In this field, you can choose to bid for `EVERYTIME` (Each Purchase)/ `NONE` (Unique Purchase).| ##|availability_status|string| Event availability status, optional values: `INACTIVE` (unavailable), `INSUFFICIENT_POSTBACK` (unavailable: insufficient postback), `READY` (available) | ##|conversions|number| Conversion events postback in the past 30 days | ##|unlock_threshold|number| Event available conversion event threshold (when `conversions` reach `unlock_threshold`, `availability_status` will change from `INSUFFICIENT_POSTBACK` to `READY`)| ##|is_beta|boolean| Whether the event is in beta | ##|bid_type_availability|object| Availability of bid types and deep bid types | ###|no_bid_enabled|boolean| Whether the event supports `bid_type` = `BID_TYPE_NO_BID` (Maximum Delivery) | ###|auto_bid_enabled|boolean| Whether the event supports `deep_bid_type` = `PACING` (auto bid) | ###|multi_bid_enabled|boolean| Whether the event supports `deep_bid_type` = `MIN` (multi bid) | ##|deep_optimization_events |object| deep conversion events | ###|optimization_event|string|deep conversion events, see[Appendix-Conversion Events-App Secondary-goal Event Type](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739361474981889)| ###|statistic_type| string | deep conversion bid statistic type, bid for `EVERYTIME` (Each Purchase)/ `NONE` (Unique Purchase)| ###|availability_status|string| Event availability status. Enum values: `INACTIVE` (unavailable), `INSUFFICIENT_POSTBACK` (unavailable: insufficient postback), `READY` (available) | ###|conversions|number| Conversion events postback in the past 30 days | ###|unlock_threshold|number| Event available conversion event threshold (when `conversions` reach `unlock_threshold`, `availability_status` will change from `INSUFFICIENT_POSTBACK` to `READY`)| |request_id |string|The log id of a request, which uniquely identifies the request.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "data": { "external_actions": [ { "conversions": 59, "unlock_threshold": 50, "deep_external_actions": [], "statistic_type": "NONE", "availability_status": "READY", "external_action": "COMPLETE_TUTORIAL", "is_beta": false }, { "conversions": 12, "unlock_threshold": 50, "deep_external_actions": [], "statistic_type": "NONE", "availability_status": "INSUFFICIENT_POSTBACK", "external_action": "SUBSCRIBE", "is_beta": false }, { "conversions": 0, "unlock_threshold": 50, "deep_external_actions": [], "statistic_type": "NONE", "availability_status": "INACTIVE", "external_action": "ADD_PAYMENT_INFO", "is_beta": false }, { "conversions": 0, "unlock_threshold": 50, "deep_external_actions": [], "statistic_type": "NONE", "availability_status": "INACTIVE", "external_action": "SEARCH", "is_beta": false }, { "conversions": 0, "unlock_threshold": 50, "deep_external_actions": [], "statistic_type": "NONE", "availability_status": "INACTIVE", "external_action": "ACTIVE_REGISTER", "is_beta": false }, { "conversions": 0, "unlock_threshold": 50, "deep_external_actions": [], "statistic_type": "NONE", "availability_status": "INACTIVE", "external_action": "IN_APP_DETAIL_UV", "is_beta": false }, { "conversions": 0, "unlock_threshold": 50, "deep_external_actions": [], "statistic_type": "NONE", "availability_status": "INACTIVE", "external_action": "START_TRIAL", "is_beta": false }, { "conversions": 0, "unlock_threshold": 50, "deep_external_actions": [], "statistic_type": "NONE", "availability_status": "INACTIVE", "external_action": "LOGIN", "is_beta": false } ], "multi_bid_enabled": false }, "request_id": "2020111207432201023125009013555" } (/code); ```
